task_context.reference_solution: Since $\cos{C}=\frac{9\sqrt{130}}{130}$ and $\cos{C}=\frac{AC}{BC}$, we have $\frac{AC}{BC}=\frac{AC}{\sqrt{130}}=\frac{9\sqrt{130}}{130}$.  This means that $AC=\frac{9\sqrt{130}}{130}\cdot\sqrt{130}=\frac{9\cdot\sqrt{130}\cdot\sqrt{130}}{130}=\boxed{9}$.
